category: hosted debrid bot (file-host link to download link)

free_tier.stated: Inherits the Deepbrid account tier. The site's own FAQ: 'With the free account you will be able to fetch up to 5 cloud provider links every day.'
free_tier.notes: the bot has no separate allowance; it reads the account behind the API key

per_object_cap.stated: No per-file cap is published for the bot. The paid trial advertises a '200GB Max Download Size', which is a plan ceiling, not a per-object one.
per_object_cap.notes: the 200 GB figure belongs to the 14-day trial listed at EUR 4.50

retention.stated: Nothing is stored: the bot returns a premium URL from Deepbrid's download servers. The life of that URL is not stated on the page read.

egress.terms: No Telegram traffic. 'Generate premium links, manage torrents, check your stats' in a private chat; the bytes come from premium-dl.deepbrid.com.
egress.free_allowance: none: the free allowance is a link count, not bytes

interface_detail: A private Telegram chat. Setup is '/setkey <api_key>': 'Store your Deepbrid API key. The bot validates it immediately and deletes your message for security.'
tooling: Any Telegram client plus a Deepbrid account API key from the Devices page. Torrents and usenet are accepted as magnets, .torrent and .nzb files dropped in the chat.
chaining: Turns a magnet, .nzb or 80+ file-host links into a premium URL without leaving Telegram, so the retrieval path is Deepbrid's servers, not Telegram's; needs a paid plan for volume.

limits.value: 5 cloud-provider links/day on a free account
'200GB Max Download Size' on the paid trial only

binding_note: Five links a day is the free wall; a link count is not a byte quota, so the failure mode is 'no more links today', not 'quota exhausted'.

identity_cost.detail: The bot needs a Deepbrid account's API key, so the account must exist first. The signup fields were not read; email is the minimum such an account implies and is not confirmed.

reliability_note: Per-hoster daily traffic and link limits apply and the bot can show them but not raise them; an invalid or rotated API key stops the bot with /checkkey.
confidence_note: The 5-link free allowance and the API-key mechanism are on the vendor pages read. Whether the bot answers a message was not tested (no Telegram account).

evidence.proved: '/setkey <api_key> Store your Deepbrid API key.' and 'Send magnet links, drop .torrent or .nzb files directly in chat' and 'Per-Hoster Limits - View your daily traffic and link limits per hoster in real time'
'With the free account you will be able to fetch up to 5 cloud provider links every day.'
paid tiers: '14 Days Trial EUR 4.50' with '200GB Max Download Size'
the handle resolves to a bot titled 'Deepbrid - Official Telegram Bot' with a Start action

price_per_tb_month: not comparable: sold as link counts and plan bandwidth, not bytes
notes: Abandon if /setkey disappears or the free link count changes. The bot is a remote control for a debrid account: it adds no Telegram capacity and is not a way to store bytes.
